title: Index Pairs of a String
description: Given a string text and an array of strings words, return all index pairs [i, j] such that the substring text[i...j] is in words.
pseudocode:
1. result = []
2. for i from 0 to text.length - 1:
3.   for j from i to text.length - 1:
4.     if words.includes(text.substring(i, j + 1)):
5.       result.push([i, j])
6. return result

steps.note: Start inner loop j = 0. Substring: 'a'. Exists in words.
Inner loop j = 1. Substring: 'ab'. Not in words.
Inner loop j = 2. Substring: 'aba'. Exists in words.
Inner loop j = 1. Substring: 'b'. Not in words.
Inner loop j = 2. Substring: 'ba'. Not in words.
Inner loop j = 2. Substring: 'a'. Exists in words.
